title: Unit Testing with Jest & Component Harnesses

questions.prompt: What does TestBed provide for a component test?

options.text: A fresh, isolated Angular injector and compiled component tree per test, without booting the whole app

questions.explanation: TestBed builds a throwaway module and injector so each test starts clean and components render in isolation.

questions.prompt: Why prefer await fixture.whenStable() over fixture.detectChanges() in zoneless tests?

options.text: It waits for Angular's reactive scheduling to settle, matching production, while detectChanges() forces a synchronous pass that can mask scheduling issues

questions.explanation: whenStable() waits for Angular's own scheduling to settle, the way production does; detectChanges() forces a synchronous pass that can hide scheduling problems.

questions.prompt: What problem do Angular CDK Component Harnesses solve?

options.text: They make tests run in a real browser
They replace brittle CSS-selector/DOM queries with a stable, behavior-based API, so markup refactors don't break tests

questions.explanation: A harness exposes methods like click()/getText(); only the harness's internal selectors change when markup does.

questions.prompt: Why do locatorFor()/locatorForAll() return functions rather than cached element references?

options.text: So they re-query the DOM on each call, staying correct across @if/@for re-renders
Because Angular requires all locators to be async

questions.explanation: Control-flow blocks destroy and recreate nodes, so a cached reference would go stale; re-querying keeps it valid.

questions.prompt: In a Vitest project (the default since Angular 21), which API wraps an existing service method so you can assert on its calls?
questions.explanation: vi.spyOn wraps the real method so you can assert calls and optionally replace the implementation. Jasmine and Jest spy APIs do not exist in a Vitest project.

questions.prompt: Which adapter creates a HarnessLoader from a TestBed ComponentFixture (e.g. ____.loader(fixture))?
questions.explanation: TestbedHarnessEnvironment.loader(fixture) bridges a TestBed fixture to the CDK harness system.
